spec.purpose: Track the six journeys that connect the public configuration review to ConfigHub promotion and delivery. Technical proof and ordinary-user proof are recorded separately.

journeys.limit: One public NGINX chart and values example. Private dependency authentication and an outside-user trial remain open.
journeys.question: Can I turn Helm values written by AI into exact reviewed objects and OCI?

journeys.limit: The digest-preserving handoff is proved for one literal Kubernetes object set. The public browser does not perform the authenticated upload.
journeys.question: Can I retain the same reviewed OCI as a ConfigHub base without changing its objects?

journeys.limit: One NGINX capacity rule on one throwaway target. It is not a production sizing recommendation or a general promotion UI test.
journeys.question: Can I test exact candidates, compare the accepted result with production, and promote the selected revision?

journeys.limit: One chart, version pair, Argo CD path, and kind target. Automatic route selection and rollback have not run.
journeys.question: Can I check hooks, CRDs, prerequisites, namespaces, and delivery mechanics after the final candidate exists?

journeys.limit: Argo CD is proved for this lifecycle-heavy path. Flux has a separate source-OCI proof, not this ConfigHub release, and no long soak was run.
journeys.question: Can I promote an exact ConfigHub release, deliver it through GitOps, and check the resulting live state?

journeys.limit: The NGINX answer is retained and public. No outside user has yet completed the response process from question submission to accepted Catalog answer.
journeys.question: Can a useful public investigation become a retained Catalog answer with its decision and limits visible?
